app.tagline: ePER parts catalogue, read in the browser

backup.title: Your own data
backup.note: The bin, your notes, the interface language and where you were. None of it can be re-derived from a disc, which is why it is the only thing here worth backing up.
backup.imported: Imported: {{added}} notes added, {{updated}} updated, {{kept}} kept; {{bin}} bin lines.
backup.importedPrefs: Preferences restored — reload to apply them.
backup.importFailed: That file held nothing eperx could read.
backup.sourceNote: The data source is not included: a saved folder cannot be serialised, and a hosted URL is better handed over as a ?data= link.

bin.title: Parts bin
bin.empty: Nothing in the bin yet. Add parts from a drawing.
bin.name: Description

footer.queries: SQL statements run against the tree
footer.drawingBytes: The drawing itself, one ranged read

note.title: Note on {{part}}
note.placeholder: What you know about this part
note.importFailed: That file held no notes eperx could read.

parts.title: Parts
parts.hidden_one: {{count}} row hidden: this vehicle cannot have it.
parts.hidden_other: {{count}} rows hidden: this vehicle cannot have them.
parts.empty: Pick a subgroup to see its parts.
parts.usages: Pick a part to see every drawing it appears on.
parts.allFiltered: Every callout is hidden: this vehicle can have none of them.

search.title: Search
search.pickPart: Pick a part to see every drawing it appears on.

settings.title: Settings
settings.interfaceLanguageNote: The language of eperx's own words. The catalogue's own text is chosen in the toolbar, and depends on which languages the tree was imported with.

strip.filterTitle: Hide drawings and parts this vehicle definitely cannot have
strip.noVehicle: No vehicle chosen — every drawing is shown

toolbar.readingFrom: Where the catalogue is being read from

vin.title: Look the vehicle up by VIN
vin.unavailable: This tree was imported without the chassis files
vin.snapshot: A disc is a snapshot; vehicles built after it was pressed are absent.
vin.explain: A Fiat-group VIN carries the model type code and the chassis number, which is how ePER's own index is keyed.
